decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains close to the firm's certified specialist-lighting capabilities and customer base, so feedback can be absorbed and used to improve the line rather than exit it.

The spring-balanced desk lamp builds on the firm's ergonomic office-lighting know-how, but as a more peripheral standalone product it faces a higher pruning risk if it does not earn its place against smarter system offerings.
This general interior luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core indoor-lighting platform and channels, giving management strong ability to interpret demand and refine it with relatively low risk.

As a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic move toward advanced, high-quality interior lighting, it benefits strongly from existing optics and application knowledge and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.

Although marine searchlights use related specialist-lighting knowledge, the HMI technology is increasingly misaligned with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led development path, so management would likely reallocate resources away from it.
